I've been playing with my stepson and this game has brought back that old vibe of playing online games. The community is incredible. You can play friendly and folks will actually work together. You can be hostile and cut down a lobby of raiders, too. The game seems to notice how you play and put you in lobbies with folks who behave similarly. It's been an excellent experience both ways, aggro and friendly, and I highly recommend this game to anyone who wants to have interesting, fun experiences with real strangers, as well as friends.

My stepson and I met a group of 8 other players on Spaceport, it was a special loot event on the map and we had a battery that was needed to access it. The group cleaned out the loot in no time flat, and it wasn't very profitable for either of us, but the experience of having that much of a lobby all working together was incredible and something I look forward to much more of with this game.

I enjoy the pve side of this game alot, solos if you dont shoot anyone will almost always be pve lobbies. People are friendly sharing blueprints they already have, and working together to kill the big arcs its overall a good experience. (for solo with pve lobbies) 

However, pvp is very much a part of this game you will run into people camping in buildings hiding in dark corners with a shot shotgun, you will get jump scares from both arc and players. You also will get shot in the back after someone says "friendly." Hell someone you run around looting with can shoot you in the back while extracting together. Learn to keep your guard up if you want to be friendly still.

Duo lobbies for me have been about 50/50 on friendly and pvp, you may run into a duo running threw a friendly lobby no problem.(most likely cause they've gotten s**t on multiple times in a row) The "ABMM" is decent for duos trys its best to give you what you put out.

Now Trio lobbies......I have not ever been in a full friendly lobby in trios, most people when they're with "the boys" just run around together and shoot everyone on sight it is very little pve and mostly pvp. If you happen to have to deal with a Bastion, Bombardier , or a Rocketeer you will most likely get third partied and then the 3rd party with get 4th partied (which is satisfying.) If you play with the boys in a full trio be prepared for war trust no one. 

Ratings: 

SOLO - Reflects what you do in lobbies best PVE 9/10 , PVP 5/10 (the friendlys will hunt you down like a rabid beast if your in a 99% friendly lobby)

DUO- PVE 7/10 still refects what you do in lobbies but can still put with rats and corner campers be ready, PVP 7/10 Duo is a good mix of PVE and PVP you just gotta be more careful who you let get close 

TRIOS - PVE 3/10 still possible but will get shot in the back 99% of the time, PVP 9/10 most PVP heavy mode ive played (with my passive shot only when shot playstyle) however the pvp in this game is fun and its apart of the game you have to accept 

I 100% recommend this game if you can accept defeat even when fights arn't fair the community can be helpful and friendly but also ruthless and brutal choose what side you want

Downvoting this over what happened between Nessie and Peaachxo.

What happened: Nessie and his friend queue up and lure people into a room, saying one of them is stuck and needs help getting dislodged or whatever. Lures the person into the room, locks them in, and proceeds to kill them. Typical Rat Behavior. Crappy? Yes. Illegal? No. Peach ends up being their latest victim.

After being killed, she reports him for 'scamming', saying Nessie is a liar and he got her killed. Her community (if it can be called that) of 20 people watching her streams at any given time then proceed to flame him and call him all sorts of messed up stuff in chat. Thats where it should have ended.

It didn't.

Turns out, shes best friends with someone that works at Embark Studios (the creator of Arc Raiders), the community lead known as Ossen. She informs Ossen about what happened, and then Ossen ends up banning Nessie for 30 days, with no investigation, nothing, just takes Peaachxo's word for it.

Nessie then makes an unlisted youtube video compiling all their interactions and Peaachxo's stream vids and sends it to embark and appeals his ban. Ossen responds to it after several days with "Gee that must be uncomfortable, i'll lift the ban, but you have to promise to leave her alone and avoid her at all costs!" (in a game with random match making, btw. see the stupidity here?)

Nessie gets unbanned after 5 days. He then decides to reupload the video to youtube and make it public in order to clear his name (because throughout all this, hes still getting insulted and flamed by anyone who is a fan of her) then the video gets flagged by youtube for copyright, Peaachxo apparently found out and if you're unfamiliar with youtube copyright strikes, you have to provide your personal information to make a counterclaim to fight to get your video back.

Well, it still gets worse.

She then takes that personal information and reports it to the police, probably trying to get him swatted. Yeah, she effectively doxxed him, in order to cause real punishment with the law, over some in-game interactions.

And Embark? They didn't do a damn thing about it, Neither did Twitch for that matter, but we all know how crappy twitch is.

The fact that Peaachxo isn't even banned from either the twitch platform, or ARC or youtube for what shes done is mind-boggling. And since Embark is complicit in how things led to this nonsense outcome, you get a downvote. Ossen needs to be fired and blacklisted from the gaming industry,

Oh, and the game is overran by aimbotters/ESP users anyway.
